flags.issue: Undecidable: the proposed framework mentions traditional tools, automated syntax/policy checks, and static-analysis queries, but does not specify that a deterministic non-AI analyser or rule engine computes the validation verdict rather than an LLM agent.

TESTS: sandboxed targeted executions, including edge-case and randomized-dataset runs; AUTHOR: unclear — reviewers can request executions, but the paper does not state who creates the executable test cases or whether they are generated by an agent.
